li.label: lucky
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a knack for landing on the right side of a coin. At the casino {PAWN_pronoun} is dealt a slightly kinder payout plan. Every tenth lottery ticket is free.

li.label: unlucky
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} drops toast butter-side down and chases losses a little too hard. Payouts at the casino run slightly worse for {PAWN_objective}.

li.label: gambling-averse
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} refuses to gamble and is uneasy in rooms where others do. In return {PAWN_pronoun} is a sharp-eyed cashier who notices forged chips.

li.label: gambler
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} loves the table: the spin, the shuffle, the pause before the card turns. Gambling is more fun, and more dangerous, for {PAWN_objective}. Makes a lively croupier.

li.label: born host
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers names, refills glasses before they are empty and makes strangers feel expected. Learns hosting faster.

li.label: grump
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} runs the front desk like a customs post. Guests complain, but nothing ever goes missing from {PAWN_possessive} rooms.

li.label: penny-pincher
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} reads every line of every contract, twice. Pays lower bank fees and spots pre-ticked extras. Guests find {PAWN_possessive} prices a little steep.

li.label: silver tongue
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} could talk a river into a different bed. Guests expect a little less when {PAWN_pronoun} is around, and buying a guest's loyalty comes cheaper.

li.label: eagle eye
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sees the palmed card, the swapped chip and the guest who pockets the spoon.

li.label: steady hands
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s fingers do not shake: a dealer's dream, and a house cheater's.

li.label: caregiver
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} sits with the sick, reads to the children and notices who is not eating. Patients and families in {PAWN_possessive} care do better.

li.label: peacemaker
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} steps between raised voices and turns them down again. Fights in {PAWN_possessive} room are rarer and end sooner.

li.label: gossip
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} cannot keep a story to {PAWN_objective}self. What guests do, good or bad, travels further.

li.label: kid magnet
li.description: Children follow {PAWN_nameDef} around like ducklings. Families are happier, and the play room is in good hands.

li.label: lucky streak
li.description: The dice keep falling my way tonight.

li.label: of course I lost
li.description: Of course I lost. Of course.

li.label: gambling nearby
li.description: People are throwing money away right in front of me.
